source_of_truth: v1.1.23 tagged AST and parser source

coverage_contract.goal: Exercise every mapped Aiken v1.1.23 language and compiler surface plus every active UPLC builtin.
coverage_contract.pass_condition: Every positive row and builtin has verified evidence in all required lanes. Every negative row has the expected diagnostic under both compiler variants.
coverage_contract.version_pair_rule: The newer compiler defines the inventory. Only rows accepted by both compilers and emitted as UPLC by both compilers enter Lean-blaster.

lanes.compile: Parse and type-check the same pinned source with both compiler variants.
lanes.blaster: Build reachable validator UPLC with both compiler variants and compare the pair with Lean-blaster.
lanes.check: Run unit, property, and validator tests with fixed options and seeds.
lanes.bench: Discover and run benchmark definitions with the same Sampler inputs.
lanes.config: Exercise target, environment, configuration, dependency, lockfile, and monorepo selection.
lanes.docs: Exercise source documentation generation. This lane does not enter Blaster.
